'''Voron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] recon specialist of [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] living on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was killed by an individual aligned with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Recon Specialist Voron appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Alderaan.<ref name="SWTOR" />
